description: Use when the accepted inputs or produced outputs for SvelteKit application workflows need a checkable boundary. Produce an input/output contract for SvelteKit application workflows with types, required fields, exclusions, and representative approved fixtures. Success means the contract names its source and version, boundary cases are visible, and no private or unapproved payload is needed to explain the result. The review is bounded to server/client execution boundaries, route data, form handling, and secret isolation. Use only authorized local evidence, version-matched authoritative references, and synthetic or approved fixtures. Do not install tools, expose credentials, change live systems, publish, contact people, or make irreversible decisions without explicit approval; stop when authority or recovery is unclear.
